Treat supplies, explained for regular visitors
They often ask us about it
Travel supplies at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

Aurelia Skyways keeps animal travel moving with steady checks and clear handoffs. This article covers the basic supply flow for travelers who bring a companion animal through the desk.

Use approved supplies only, and pack them so staff can inspect each item without delay. Keep food, water, liners, and cleaning material in easy reach. The desk updates service notes in the ledger when a supply issue changes the plan, so bring what you need before you arrive.

If a pet needs special handling, tell the desk early and stay with the item until staff confirms receipt. <<FACT F105>> Keep documents together and place the items in a clean carrier or crate that is secure, ventilated, and ready for screening. The process stays smoother when you label the carrier clearly and avoid loose extras.

For transfer moves, the desk follows a standard record trail. <<FACT F088>> Pack only the supplies that support the animal's comfort and safety, and remove anything that could shift during transit. The team will check condition, note exceptions, and guide you if anything needs to be replaced before the next leg.

On arrival pickup, the desk works with the local staff member who manages the release step. <<FACT F101>> Have the carrier ready, keep your travel papers close, and wait for the release signal before opening the door.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before you travel.
